build_base_response: build a base ModelResponse from a list of streaming chunks with id, model, role, and finish reason
get_combined_tool_content: get combined tool call content from a list of streaming chunks by merging partial function arguments
get_combined_content: get combined content string from a list of streaming chunks by concatenating delta content values
calculate_usage: calculate token usage from streaming chunks including prompt tokens, completion tokens, and caching info
concatenate_base64_list: concatenate a list of base64-encoded strings by decoding, joining, and re-encoding as a single base64 string
